responsibilities.description: Puts together the quarterly report: works out the quarter's date window, groups hives by the region of their apiary, and returns per-region reports sorted by region name.
responsibilities.name: Quarterly regional report compilation

responsibilities.description: Turns a quarter (year and quarter number) into a UTC date range and checks whether a date falls inside that quarter.
responsibilities.name: Quarter period calculation

responsibilities.description: Counts hives flagged for varroa as of the end of the quarter in each region and calculates the flagged share of that region's hives.
responsibilities.name: Varroa-flagged share calculation

responsibilities.description: Counts the treatments started in the quarter, grouped by treatment product name. If a product has no name, its id is used instead.
responsibilities.name: Treatment counts per product

responsibilities.description: Adds up the kilograms of honey harvested in each region during the quarter.
responsibilities.name: Honey harvest totals
